title: Workspace API common value types
description: Value types every workspace services API v1 schema shares: docs/specs/workspace-api.md §3.1, §6.1, API-14, API-18; journal spec §2, §3, §4.6, §4.7 (DEC-740). Definitions only; it validates nothing on its own. The envelope and problem types are envelope.schema.json's.

Decimal.description: Journal spec §4.6 canonical decimal, as a string; never a JSON number. The pattern fixes the form (no exponent, sign, leading zero, trailing fractional zero, or -0; at most 28 fractional digits); the magnitude bound (below 7.9e28) is the parser's.

Timestamp.description: Journal spec §4.7: UTC with nine fractional digits, years 1970 to 9999. The pattern also refuses a day past its month's length (31 only in the 31-day months, February at most 29); whether February 29 falls in a leap year is the parser's refusal (DEC-740 item 3).

ContentRef.description: A SHA-256 content hash or artifact reference (§3.1).

Id.description: An opaque id (§3.1, journal spec §2's identifier grammar); it embeds no name, instrument, or personal datum.

AssetId.description: An instrument's asset id: the mandate schema's `uuid`, lowercase only (mandate spec §3, journal spec §9.3's `asset_id`).

EventId.description: A journal event id: a ULID in Crockford base32 (journal spec §3). Its time component carries no meaning.

Watermark.description: §6.1: the last event of one stream a response reflects. `stream_id` follows journal spec §2; `hash` is that event's hash written as a sha256: ref (§3.1): the journal stores and pages (API-15) the bare 64 lowercase hex digits as `hash` and `prev_hash`, and the API adds the `sha256:` prefix in watermarks.

stream_id.description: Journal spec §2: `acct:{workspace_id}:{account_ref}` and `agent:{workspace_id}:{agent_id}` have two segments; `ctl`, `clock`, and `ntf` have the workspace id alone. Every segment matches [A-Za-z0-9_-]+.

AsOf.description: §6.1, API-14: one watermark for each stream a response read.

Freshness.description: Per-value staleness (§6.1, API-14, brief §3.1). `observed_at` is when the value was observed; `age_seconds` is whole seconds from then to when the server built the response; `stale` is the server's judgment against the limit `limit_source` names. A stale value is still returned, marked.

QuotedContent.description: API-18: model output (a chat reply, a thesis, a compiler note, a signal model's output), quoted and attributed. It is display text only: no action or control member's type is this one, and nothing in it is an action. `author` is the closed set of authorship labels (journal spec §9's evidence label, mandate spec §6.4 and §8.1): `owner_selected` is shown as "Output of software you selected", `platform_authored` as "Platform-authored". `event_id` is the journal event that recorded the output; `artifact` the stored output, or null when it is inline.

model_id.description: The model registry id, as mandate spec §8.1 writes a signal model's (`quant.momentum`).
